prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 地铁各线路首末班车时刻表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 9 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "线路" · longest unbreakable word 17px · one-line width 48px
  col 2: header "工作日首班" · longest unbreakable word 41px · one-line width 77px
  col 3: header "工作日末班" · longest unbreakable word 41px · one-line width 77px
  col 4: header "周末首班" · longest unbreakable word 42px · one-line width 62px
  col 5: header "周末末班" · longest unbreakable word 41px · one-line width 62px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助乘客查找各条地铁线路在工作日和周末的首末班车时间。","reading":"先按线路定位行，再横向读取对应日期和首末班时间；也可纵向比较不同线路的时间。表头可用两行显示，数据行保持单行以便扫描。","groups":["工作日首班与工作日末班构成一组，分别表示工作日运营的开始和结束。","周末首班与周末末班构成一组，与工作日两列对应，便于比较。","四个时间列承担相同的信息角色，应保持足够宽度以完整显示时间。"],"keep_intact":["线路名称，包括10号线、13号线和机场线","所有HH:MM格式的时间"],"may_wrap":["工作日首班、工作日末班、周末首班和周末末班表头可按中文自然换行；换行由表头行高度统一吸收。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [69, 72, 72, 73, 73] · table 360×351px · row heights [60, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 4/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [69, 80, 80, 65, 65] · table 360×351px · row heights [60, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 4/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [69, 63, 63, 82, 82] · table 360×374px · row heights [83, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 4/5 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"线路名称和时间均保持完整，数据行等高，横向查找和纵向比较都很顺畅。两组时间列宽度接近，整体均衡。","problems":"周末表头断成“周末首／班”和“周末末／班”，把“首班”“末班”拆开，削弱了表头的语义和节奏。","cause":"周末两列各73px，扣除内边距和边框后可容纳三个汉字，第四字被挤到下一行。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"表头按“工作日／首班”“工作日／末班”及“周末／首班”“周末／末班”分行，日期与首末班的对应关系清楚。所有线路名称和时间完整，数据行紧凑且容易扫描。","problems":"工作日列比周末列略宽，但这一差异与表头文字长度相符，没有明显妨碍比较。","cause":"工作日列各80px，容纳“工作日”；周末列各65px，使“周末”和“首班”或“末班”分别成行。线路列69px足以容纳最长名称。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"线路名称和所有时间完整，数据行保持单行；周末两列留有充足空间。","problems":"工作日表头被拆成三行，连“工作日”和“首班”“末班”都被拆散，增加表头高度并干扰辨认。周末列明显更宽，四个同类时间列的比例失衡。","cause":"工作日两列各63px，扣除21px后仅剩42px文本宽度；周末两列各82px，占用了工作日表头需要的空间。"}],"done":true,"designs":[]}
